description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Chamber Sentry from your library.
Repeat.
